verdict.rationale: mParticle documents connecting audiences it builds to partner audience outputs for activation, which covers the core sync-to-destinations part of the story. Nothing in the pack establishes that syncing is continuous or that members enter and exit in near-real-time. missing for 10: evidence of continuous or streaming audience sync, documented near-real-time membership entry and exit, named ad-platform and engagement-tool destinations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time

citations.quote: Once you have created an audience, you must connect it to an audience output where you can activate it.
activate audiences before risk or opportunity passes
so more of the audiences you build can be reached and activated without increasing spend
